messages:
mike_infra: Quick q — for the multi-region hosted API routing: should we bias decisions by recent p95 per-region per-customer-tier, or use an EWMA + cross-region penalty? also how does model-variant fallback fit in when preferred region is saturated?

sara_platform: Latency-first for enterprise/premium, cost-aware for self-serve. EWMA with hysteresis to avoid oscillation. prefer same-region model variants unless the delta > X ms or capacity is exhausted.

josh_pm: From a console/UX POV we need a single 'why' trace for each request: show the routing inputs (ewma, bias, quota checks, health). not a raw log dump, but a clear reason string.

elena_sre: Agree. Telemetry needs sampling tiers: full traces for debug on prod (by opt-in), 1/100 for paid, 1/1000 for free. Also we should make canary routing sticky via deterministic hashing so user traffic isn't split randomly.

ops_analytics: Heads up — when computing p95 across regions, subtract/mask cache-hit responses (prefix/KV cache) otherwise p95 is misleading. Also track per-model-version latency buckets.

mike_infra: Prototype of an internal policy payload for the routing service (WIP):

```json
{
  "policy": "latency_weighted",
  "smoothing": {"alpha": 0.18},
  "bias_by_tier": {
    "enterprise": {"prefer": "local", "max_cross_region_ms": 25},
    "startup": {"prefer": "local", "max_cross_region_ms": 75},
    "free": {"prefer": "cost", "max_cross_region_ms": 150}
  },
  "quota_check": {"enforce_remote_quota": true, "fallback_if_quota_short": true},
  "fallbacks": [
    {"when": "region_unhealthy", "action": "route_to_nearest_variant"},
    {"when": "latency_surge", "action": "degrade_to_smaller_model"}
  ]
}
```

sara_platform: Nice. Couple of rules to add: if remoted region quota < requested_tokens then fallback to next candidate or degrade model; and expose along the route why remote was skipped.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-service v1.3.2-canary -> region-us-west-2 :rocket:

elena_sre: Also add probe TTL and penalty window: probe every 3s, mark region penalized for 30s on probe fail. That reduces flapping.

josh_pm: Console mock idea — per-route card with small timeline: EWMA(local)=45ms, EWMA(remote)=38ms, bias=local, last_fail=22s ago, fallback_rate=0.7%. Put an inline link to traces. Small 'why' button for one-line reason.

ops_analytics: I'll add these to the analytics board: new charts — per-tenant regional split, tokens routed by region, avg latency by model-variant, fallback_count. Also compute a "routing_stability" score per region.

mike_infra: I'll run a 24h sim with mixed tiers + quota limits and simulate a model-variant outage to validate fallback sequence. @sara_platform can you file a UX ticket with the 'why' UI and sample text? :thumbsup:

sara_platform: Yep filing now and adding acceptance criteria. will include small copy for the 'why' reason strings. :eyes:
